# netskope_device_classification_options_list (Data Source)

DeviceClassificationOptionsList DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_device_classification_options_list" "my_deviceclassificationoptionslist" {
  os   = "...my_os..."
  type = "...my_type..."
}
```
